text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, mostly wilted and glossy with a light sheen of oil or dressing, with lobed/serrated leaf edges and pale green stalks at the bottom; spread across most of a white square plate (roughly 60-70% coverage), piled about 3-4 cm high with leaves folded over each other | 120
ITEM 2 | Small scattered pieces of bright red, slightly translucent chili or pepper strips, roughly 0.5-1 cm long, sitting on and between the greens near the center and upper left | 8
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green stalk pieces, limp and watery-looking, cut into flat segments about 3-5 cm long, sitting at the lower edge of the greens on the plate | 35
